text:
We’ve confirmed the new Isolde-class ferry is rated to carry 1,800 passengers, according to the builder’s final operating dossier we reviewed this week. The vessel, delivered to Northglass Route Authority on 14 June, is built around a twin-island boarding layout and a widened central salon deck to speed embarkation at peak terminals. In our deck audit, the operator also noted a vehicle capacity of 320 lane-metres and 54 crew positions.

- Passenger capacity: 1,800
- Delivery date: 14 June
- Vehicle space: 320 lane-metres
- Crew complement: 54
- Service route: Northglass Strait
- Primary feature: twin-island boarding system
